title: Dual ToR Mock Utility
author: theasianpianist
body: Method to apply configurations to a single ToR testbed so that it can emulate either the active or standby ToR in a dual ToR setup.

linkedPullRequests.title: [dualtor]: Add utilities for dual ToR mocking
linkedPullRequests.author: theasianpianist
linkedPullRequests.body:
* Apply config DB tables to mock dual ToR setup
* Apply kernel configurations (neighbor entries and route)
* Apply orchagent config to mock dual ToR setup

Signed-off-by: Lawrence Lee <lawlee@microsoft.com>
